youtube_description:
Scenes and voices from the 20th "Cambridge Workshop on Cool Stars, Stellar Systems, and the Sun" workshop, aka Cool Stars 20! Astronomy talks, real-live-scientists, tech failures, stunning views, music... this video has it all!

Thanks to everyone for a great week - see you in 2 years in Toulouse, France!
